items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: we used to go over to, over to this little club, and listen to, uh, Bama play music.

ctx.x: So how'd y'all meet? How'd you meet your wife?

Well, my wife came down here from, uh, from up in, uh, Laplace. Uh-huh. Months. And, uh, everybody, all the fellas was impressed. See, we used to go over to, over to this little club, and listen to, uh, Bama play music. That was the band I was going to try to remember. I can't remember nobody but Bama and Mio, that little old man played a bass. But anyway, and we, all of our youngs used to go in this club. And my wife was the little pretty girl, cab down here from Laplace. Had a long headway out here, and…
